title: OAuthProtectedResourceMetadata
description: RFC 9728 protected resource metadata the Worker serves at https://mcp.blowhorn.ai. resource is the public connect URL (MCP SDK requires it to match the URL the client opened). authorization_servers names Cloud's Hydra issuer on the Blowhorn host. Cloud's design-canonical deployment URL remains https://cloud.blowhorn.ai/mcp; the Worker forwards Bearer tokens there.

resource.description: Public MCP resource URI clients of this Worker use (must match the connect URL for the MCP OAuth client).

authorization_servers.description: Cloud's authorization server issuer on the Blowhorn host (RFC 8414).
